data.reason: Historical engine-deferred-state-20261104 is the same state-deferral mechanism and saved the same 1985 default reads; its complete screen was inconclusive (+0.355% [-0.612,+1.374]%). New geometry deferral would only avoid 6999 of 199214 path line objects (3.51%). Insufficient new work reduction to repeat that experiment. Production unchanged; no timing run.

data.hypothesis: Defer JS geometry, candidate lineage and terminal rider-state materialization until the candidate survives trajectory/impact validation; eliminate unused terminalState impact-observer argument. No arithmetic or rejection order changes.
data.counterGate: Measure avoided rejected-candidate materializations before implementing. Require exact checkpoints and clean direct phase boundaries.
data.adoption: Require complete supported screen and fresh confirmation, guards, exact checkpoints/full structural validation and simpler design. Retain failed evidence. No changes to declared protocol after results.
